editor_fly_forward.description: While the right mouse button is held in the world's view, the camera flies forward.

editor_fly_back.description: While the right mouse button is held in the world's view, the camera flies back.

editor_fly_left.description: While the right mouse button is held in the world's view, the camera flies to the left.

editor_fly_right.description: While the right mouse button is held in the world's view, the camera flies to the right.

editor_fly_up.description: While the right mouse button is held in the world's view, the camera rises.

editor_fly_down.description: While the right mouse button is held in the world's view, the camera sinks.

editor_fly_fast.description: Held while flying, the camera flies at three times its speed.
